text.en:
Barangays Pantaon, Kabasaran, Punud, Lininding, Inodaran, Luguna, Tulatula, Taguranao,
Kaoring, Panggawalupa, Baclayan, Dilasun, Bago-Ingud, Dolangan, Kalanaan, Miyanocod, Nginger, East
Madaya, Inoma, Tambak, Bumbaran, Lumbakaingud and Canibongan in the municipality of Pagayawan and
Barangays Gas, Kapayoran, Maimbalawag, Lumaginding, Pindolunan, Lodas, Bobongaranao, Tiyangel,
Bubonga-Koden, Pagalongan, Posdan, Tulatula, Kalibagat, Lumas, Tapocan, Taguranao, Madaya, Barak,
Linao, Loya, Calalanoan Dadowan, Ginawagawi-i, Paso-ay, Inaturan, Magatul, Piksan, Pimping, Tamosan,
Minabay, Pantar, Taliboka, Panggawalupa, Marinaut, Papandayan, Bowaan, Di mayong, Katipunan, Kundi,
and Salaga-an in the municipality of Pualas are hereby separated from their respective mother municipalities
and constituted into a distinct and independent municipality to be known as the Municipality of Calanogas
without in any manner affecting the legal existence of the municipalities of Pagayawan and Pualas.
The seat of government of the newly created municipality shall be in Barangay Calalanoan.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, nor or hereafter applicable to regular
municipalities shall be applicable to the new municipality of Calanogas.

The present elective officials of the municipality of Pagayawan shall perform their duties as such
in the newly created municipality until the officials of the latter shall have been duly appointed by the
President and they shall hold office until their successors shall have been elected in the election for provincial
and municipal officials following the issuance of this decree, and shall have qualified, unless sooner removed
at the pleasure of the President. Such appointive officers and employees as may be necessary to organize or to
complete the government personnel of the municipality of Calanogas shall be appointed as provided for under
existing laws.

Upon effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of the new municipality of Calanogas in
the obligations, funds, assets and other property of the municipalities of Pagayawan and Pualas shall be
transferred by the President to the newly created municipality upon recommendation of the Commission on

All laws or parts of laws as well as executive orders or regulations inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.

Done in the City of Manila, this 4th day of May in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-seven.
